review.method: Explicit coding-assistant lexical/constituent review of exact N1904 Greek and displayed LSV. Inflection, syntax, repetition and witness differences checked; pending independent peer and reader review. No raw LSV Strong-tag or inferred global lexical assignments.
review.sourceTokenization: Explicit zero-based whitespace tokens including punctuation.

3:1.sourceText: Τὸ λοιπόν, ἀδελφοί μου, χαίρετε ἐν Κυρίῳ. τὰ αὐτὰ γράφειν ὑμῖν ἐμοὶ μὲν οὐκ ὀκνηρόν, ὑμῖν δὲ ἀσφαλές.
3:1.targetText: As to the rest, my brothers, rejoice in the LORD; indeed, [it] is not tiresome to me to write to you the same things, and for you [is] sure.

groups.note: Actual ta retains T-APN in both pinned analyses and owns the English article in the same nominal phrase.

3:2.sourceText: Βλέπετε τοὺς κύνας, βλέπετε τοὺς κακοὺς ἐργάτας, βλέπετε τὴν κατατομήν.
3:2.targetText: Look out for the dogs! Look out for the evil-workers! Look out for the mutilation!

groups.note: Actual kakous retains A-APM in both pinned analyses and owns evil, the modifier within LSV evil-workers.
Actual ergatas retains N-APM in both pinned analyses and separately owns workers. The English hyphen does not merge these two Greek lexical heads.

3:3.sourceText: ἡμεῖς γάρ ἐσμεν ἡ περιτομή, οἱ Πνεύματι Θεοῦ λατρεύοντες καὶ καυχώμενοι ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἐν σαρκὶ πεποιθότες,
3:3.targetText: For we are the circumcision, who are serving God by the Spirit, and glorying in Christ Jesus, and having no trust in flesh,

groups.note: God is a lexical correspondence only: N1904 Θεοῦ is genitive modifying Spirit (by the Spirit of God); LSV makes God the object of serving, as in the TR Θεῷ reading. The shared lexical noun is preserved without claiming that its grammatical role is identical.

groups.note: Actual tis retains X-NSM in both pinned analyses and is the personal indefinite realized as any ... one. No Greek numeral or person noun is invented.

3:8.sourceText: ἀλλὰ μὲν οὖν γε καὶ ἡγοῦμαι πάντα ζημίαν εἶναι διὰ τὸ ὑπερέχον τῆς γνώσεως Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Κυρίου μου, δι’ ὃν τὰ πάντα ἐζημιώθην, καὶ ἡγοῦμαι σκύβαλα ἵνα Χριστὸν κερδήσω
3:8.targetText: yes, indeed, and I count all things to be loss, because of the excellence of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord, because of whom I suffered loss of all things, and count them to be refuse, that I may gain Christ, and be found in Him,

The complete printed TR includes a second einai after skybala, while pinned N1904 has no second being infinitive there. LSV second to be is therefore explained without assigning it to actual hegeomai25, which retains count. The actual first einai8 keeps its own first to be correspondence.

review.note: The last four groups use actual Greek3:9 tokens0–3, because LSV places and be found in Him at the end of3:8. The reinforcing ἀλλὰ μὲν οὖν γε is reviewed as the short discourse formula yes, indeed, rather than arbitrary individual function-word assignments.

3:10.sourceText: τοῦ γνῶναι αὐτὸν καὶ τὴν δύναμιν τῆς ἀναστάσεως αὐτοῦ καὶ κοινωνίαν παθημάτων αὐτοῦ, συμμορφιζόμενος τῷ θανάτῳ αὐτοῦ,

3:11.sourceText: εἴ πως καταντήσω εἰς τὴν ἐξανάστασιν τὴν ἐκ νεκρῶν.

3:12.sourceText: οὐχ ὅτι ἤδη ἔλαβον ἢ ἤδη τετελείωμαι, διώκω δὲ εἰ καὶ καταλάβω, ἐφ’ ᾧ καὶ κατελήμφθην ὑπὸ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ.
3:12.targetText: Not that I already obtained, or have already been perfected, but I pursue, if I also may lay hold of that for which I was also laid hold of by Christ Jesus;

unmappedTarget.reason: English correlative object supplied before for which; Greek has no separate demonstrative object after καταλάβω.

3:13.sourceText: ἀδελφοί, ἐγὼ ἐμαυτὸν οὔπω λογίζομαι κατειληφέναι· ἓν δέ, τὰ μὲν ὀπίσω ἐπιλανθανόμενος τοῖς δὲ ἔμπροσθεν ἐπεκτεινόμενος,
3:13.targetText: brothers, I do not reckon myself to have laid hold [of it], but one thing [I do]—indeed forgetting the things behind, and stretching forth to the things before—

groups.note: N1904 οὔπω means not yet, while LSV renders not (the TR has οὐ). The negative word is linked, with the unexpressed yet aspect recorded here rather than invented.
